tools.name: fetch_html
tools.description: Fetch the fully rendered HTML of any web page through the ScrapeUnblocker API (https://developers.scrapeunblocker.com), bypassing anti-bot protection (Cloudflare, DataDome, PerimeterX, Akamai, Shape). Use when a normal fetch is blocked (403/429, captcha) or the page needs a real browser. Returns raw

tools.name: fetch_parsed
tools.description: Fetch a web page through the ScrapeUnblocker API (https://developers.scrapeunblocker.com) and return AI-parsed structured JSON instead of raw HTML (product details, article content, listings).

tools.name: google_search
tools.description: Run a Google search through the ScrapeUnblocker API (https://developers.scrapeunblocker.com) and return organic results as JSON.
